# ytChaptered

> Turn timestamped YouTube videos into structured local courses.

ytChaptered is a free, local-first web application and Progressive Web App (PWA) that converts long YouTube videos with chapter timestamps into interactive, segment-by-segment courses. All course content, notes, and completion states are stored client-side in the user's browser via IndexedDB and localStorage, with no accounts, sign-ups, or servers required.

## Core Capabilities
- **Automatic Chapter Detection**: Extracts video titles, channel information, and chapter timestamps from YouTube URLs or pasted description text.
- **Interactive Chapter Player**: Clean distraction-free player with automatic chapter highlighting, segment looping, speed control, and completion checkmarks.
- **Local Course Library**: Preserves course progress, resume timestamps, and completed chapters entirely on device.
- **Offline & PWA Support**: Installable on desktop and mobile devices with fast launch shortcuts.
